描述_EN: the teenage mutant ninja turtles have been a hugely popular phenomenon, originating from a comic book in the early 1980s and becoming a television cartoon series and films in the late 1980s-1990s and more recently an animated film released in 2007. there have been a large array of ninja turtles merchandise, with these types of figurines being originally produced in 1987 for the first tv series and then re-marketed and updated for a new wave of fans early in the 2000s.
